map.吹胀比（BUR）= 制品直径 / 型坯直径，一般取 2-4。吹胀比过大易导致壁薄: Blow-up ratio (BUR) = product diameter / parison diameter, generally taken as 2-4. Too large a blow-up ratio easily causes uneven wall thinning, while too small a ratio gives an unclear product contour.
map.瓶坯/容器吹塑工艺设计时，用吹胀比 BUR=制品直径÷型坯直径 评估壁厚均匀性（: When designing a bottle or container blow molding process, use the blow-up ratio BUR = product diameter ÷ parison diameter to assess wall thickness uniformity (2 to 4 is the suitable range).
map.壁厚设计时，用制品壁厚=型坯壁厚÷BUR 推算实际壁厚与减薄率，避免吹薄穿孔或局: For wall thickness design, use product wall thickness = parison wall thickness ÷ BUR to derive the actual wall thickness and thinning ratio, avoiding blow-through or locally excessive thickness.
map.设备选型时，用薄膜环向应力公式 最小吹胀压力=2×材料屈服强度×壁厚÷直径 反推: For equipment selection, use the film hoop-stress formula minimum blow pressure = 2 × material yield strength × wall thickness ÷ diameter to back-calculate the air compressor pressure requirement.
map.某瓶制品直径 100 mm、型坯直径 30 mm → 吹胀比 BUR = 100: A bottle with product diameter 100 mm and parison diameter 30 mm → BUR = 100 ÷ 30 ≈ 3.33 (suitable range 2 to 4); parison wall thickness 4 mm ÷ 3.33 ≈ product wall thickness 1.20 mm, wall thinning ratio 70.0%. If the material yield strength is 30 MPa, the product wall thickness 1.2 mm and the bottle diameter 80 mm, the theoretical minimum blow pressure = 2 × 30 × 1.2 ÷ 80 = 0.90 MPa, and a 1.5 safety factor gives a recommended ≈ 1.35 MPa (about 13.5 bar).
map.吹胀比为什么 2~4 适宜？: Why is a blow-up ratio of 2 to 4 suitable?
map.BUR 过大（>5）型坯被拉得太薄、壁厚不均与穿孔风险骤增；过小（<2）则型坯过: With too large a BUR (>5) the parison is stretched too thin and the risk of uneven wall thickness and blow-through rises sharply; with too small a ratio (<2) the parison is too thick, wasting material and making it hard to blow against the mould wall. A ratio of 2 to 4 balances wall uniformity and material economy.
map.吹胀压力怎么估算？: How is the blow pressure estimated?
map.按环向应力平衡：吹胀压力 P 须使 2×σ_t×t/D ≤ 材料屈服，故最小 P: From hoop-stress balance: the blow pressure P must satisfy 2 × σ_t × t / D ≤ the material yield, so the minimum P = 2 × σ_t × t / D; multiply by a safety factor of 1.5 for the recommended pressure, and convert to bar (×10) or psi (×145) for equipment selection.

map.吹胀比 BUR = 制品直径 ÷ 型坯直径；圆截面面积比 = BUR²（不是通用: BUR = product diameter ÷ parison diameter; circular cross-section area ratio = BUR² (not general surface-area elongation); area stretch ratio with axial stretch = BUR² × axial stretch. Wall thickness ≈ parison wall ÷ (BUR × axial stretch), uniform biaxial deformation only. BUR 2–4 suitable, 4–5 high, >5 excessive with thin-wall warning, <2 low; reject diameter ≤0 or axial stretch ≤0.

A bottle with product diameter 100 mm and parison diameter 30 mm → BUR = 100÷30 ≈ 3.33; the circumferential-only model gives 4 mm÷3.33 ≈ 1.20 mm wall and 70.0% thinning. With axial stretch 1.5, wall ≈ 4÷(3.33×1.5) = 0.80 mm and area stretch 3.33²×1.5 ≈ 16.65. The pressure tab gives 2×30×1.2÷80 = 0.90 MPa at 30 MPa yield, 1.2 mm wall and 80 mm diameter; this is only a static hoop-stress conversion, and actual forming pressure must be established by process trials.
map.吹胀比为什么常取 2~4？: Why is a blow ratio of 2–4 common?
map.BUR 过大（>5）型坯被拉得太薄、壁厚不均与穿孔风险上升；过小（<2）则型坯过: At BUR >5 the parison is stretched too thin and uneven wall/perforation risk rises; below 2 it is too thick, wastes material and is hard to blow against the mold. This range is empirical and still requires trials with the actual material, parison temperature and mold clearance.
map.压力页的 P=2σt/D 能当推荐压力吗？: Can the pressure tab's P=2σt/D be used as a recommended pressure?
map.不能。该式只是常温薄壁圆筒环向应力与内压的静态关系，未考虑热态熔体、应变速率、型: No. It is only the static relation between hoop stress and internal pressure for a thin-wall cylinder at room temperature; it ignores hot melt, strain rate, parison shape, mold-contact gap and line pressure loss. The page has withdrawn the minimum/recommended pressure and compressor-sizing conclusions.

Actual wall thickness also depends on temperature, strain rate, axial parison thickness distribution and mold-contact history.
map.模型：壁厚≈型坯壁厚÷(周向吹胀比×轴向拉伸比)，假设体积守恒、均匀双向拉伸、无: Model: wall ≈ parison wall ÷ (circumferential blow ratio × axial stretch), assuming volume conservation, uniform biaxial stretching and no local thinning; injection-stretch-blow cases must include axial stretch or the result will be too thick.
map.⚠️ 这不是热态型坯吹胀与贴模所需的“最低压力”或“推荐压力”，也不用于空压机选: ⚠️ This is not the minimum or recommended pressure needed to inflate a hot parison against the mold, nor a basis for compressor sizing. The model ignores melt temperature, strain rate, cooling, parison shape, mold clearance and pressure loss; actual forming pressure must be confirmed by trials or equipment manuals.
